{{Quote|I forged a death mark signed by the Hutt against the Mandalorian clan. They "accidentally" found it with a little help from yours truly.|Doc|<ref name="Anonymous">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Anonymous}}</ref>}}
A '''clan''' of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Anonymous" /> Sometime between [[3647 BBY|3647]]<ref name="Codex" />&ndash;[[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> after a severe [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]], a [[Unidentified Hutt (medpacs)|local]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] began hoarding [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] in his [[Unidentified Hutt's palace|palace]] and selling them at a high price, causing the combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]]&mdash;better known as Doc&mdash;to forge a false [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] against the clan. Doc arranged for the clan to learn of the death mark, and the clan, believing that the Hutt had issued the death mark, [[Attack on a Hutt's palace|attacked]] the Hutt's palace. Doc stole medpacs from the palace during the chaos, though both the members of the clan and the Hutt were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fighting.<ref name="Anonymous" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian clan was first mentioned in the conversation "Anonymous" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Anonymous" />
